india.one_line: India sees major AI infrastructure investment and a new venture fund launch.

themes.title: Tata Communications builds AI‑ready fibre network
themes.text: Tata Communications will invest up to $450 million to construct about 10,000 km of high‑speed fibre linking AI data‑centre corridors, starting with the Mumbai‑Pune‑Hyderabad‑Chennai route, targeting hyperscalers, AI platforms, enterprises and a connectivity market exceeding $1 billion.

stories.headline: Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India
Tata Communications to spend $450 million on 10,000 km AI‑ready fibre network in India

themes.title: Unacademy founders launch AI deep‑tech fund
themes.text: Unacademy co‑founders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini are raising a ₹700 crore venture fund, Longshot Capital, to invest in 25‑28 seed and pre‑Series A AI and deep‑tech startups, with cheques of $500,000‑$1.5 million, aiming for a first close in January 2027.

stories.headline: Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital
